feedback_loops.name: Hodgkin-Huxley Membrane Equation
feedback_loops.description: Main membrane potential equation from the Hodgkin-Huxley model describing action potential generation
feedback_loops.symbolic: C_m * Derivative(V, t) + g_Na * m**3 * h * (V - E_Na) + g_K * n**4 * (V - E_K) + g_L * (V - E_L) - I_ext
feedback_loops.latex: C_m \frac{dV}{dt} = -g_{Na} m^3 h (V - E_{Na}) - g_K n^4 (V - E_K) - g_L (V - E_L) + I_{ext}
